Lightelligence.why: Sells Scale-up optical interconnect for GPU clusters (LightSphere X optical-circuit-switch supernode, OCS silicon-photonics PIC in mass production, NPO / CPO PICs); Scale-up product revenue rises with AI cluster buildouts.
Lightelligence.evidence: During the World Artificial Intelligence Conference 2026 ... we officially announced the successful deployment of a several-thousand-GPU cluster powered by LightSphere X ... with the OCS silicon photonics PIC also entering mass production.

players.product: Scale-up optical interconnect: LightSphere X GPU-supernode distributed optical circuit switch (dOCS) and OCS silicon-photonics PIC, Scale-up EPS (pluggable LPO moving to 3.2T / 6.4T NPO silicon-photonics PICs), CPO optical engines, 800G / 1.6T transceiver PICs

quarterly_data.quarter: Lightelligence press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended June (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 (six months ended June 30, 2026) results: revenue RMB79.78 million, up 284% from RMB20.79 million; consolidated gross profit margin approximately 65.8% (H1 2025: approximately 40.0%); adjusted net loss (non-IFRS) RMB147.15 million. Optical interconnect revenue grew from RMB16.17 million to RMB60.70 million (+275%), mainly from broader commercial deployment of Scale-up OCS, with Scale-up product sales rising from RMB10.92 million to RMB55.91 million and no Scale-out product revenue in the period; optical computing revenue grew from RMB4.62 million to RMB19.08 million (+313%). Substantially all revenue came from the China market. R&D expenses rose 126% to RMB349.72 million; capital expenditures were RMB53.11 million.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue RMB79.78 million (+284%); gross margin approximately 65.8%; optical interconnect RMB60.70 million (+275%); Scale-up products RMB55.91 million; optical computing RMB19.08 million (+313%); adjusted net loss RMB147.15 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Lightelligence press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended June (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: LightSphere X / OCS: at WAIC 2026 (July 2026) the company announced the successful deployment of a several-thousand-GPU cluster powered by LightSphere X, its GPU supernode solution built on distributed optical circuit switch (dOCS) technology, which it calls China's first commercialized, domestically developed optical-switching computing cluster of over 1,000 GPUs (company claim); the OCS silicon photonics PIC has entered mass production. Together with leading domestic compute-power providers (not named) it also launched a next-generation optical-switching and electrical-switching Scale-up networking solution that the company says lowers latency to the hundreds-of-nanoseconds level.
quarterly_data.figure: several-thousand-GPU LightSphere X cluster deployed; OCS silicon photonics PIC in mass production

quarterly_data.quarter: Lightelligence press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended June (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Orders and design-ins (H1 2026): following the LightSphere X launch and over a year of collaboration with some leading partners, the supernode solution achieved commercial implementation, the company received orders for OCS products from other customers (not named) and OCS pricing improved. Scale-up EPS revenue came primarily from overseas markets with stable pricing; the company has completed design-in with a number of overseas customers (not named) and established long-term cooperative relationships with leading partners.

quarterly_data.quarter: Lightelligence press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended June (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: NPO: the Scale-up EPS portfolio has transitioned from pluggable LPO to NPO. Multiple NPO silicon photonic PICs are under validation by multiple leading customers; the 3.2T NPO product passed testing in an end-customer application scenario and completed tape-out, and the 6.4T NPO product is under joint development with customers. The company has begun providing hardware samples of NPO-based Scale-up solutions, and its NPO photonic chip completed full-link validation in multiple customer projects and is 'approaching commercialization'. The company observes that leading domestic cloud service providers are advancing deployment and validation of 3.2T NPO and researching 6.4T NPO, overseas cloud providers are assessing NPO through their supply chains, and standards bodies have begun defining 6.4T/12.8T NPO standards.
quarterly_data.figure: 3.2T NPO taped out; 6.4T NPO in joint development

quarterly_data.quarter: Lightelligence press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended June (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CPO: the company completed a proof-of-concept demonstration based on next-generation switch ASICs. At WAIC 2026 it announced a strategic cooperation with a leading switch-ASIC design enterprise (not named) and jointly launched a CPO switch evaluation system, equipped with a mass-produced switch ASIC and an optical engine using Lightelligence's silicon photonic products and packaging technology; the company says this marks domestic CPO moving from concept demonstration to engineering validation (an evaluation system, not a shipping product).

quarterly_data.quarter: Lightelligence press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended June (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Scale-out transceiver PICs: progressing as planned; certain PICs are undergoing module-level testing by customers while others are at the design-iteration stage, covering 800G and 1.6T optical modules. The company says it participates in process development at partner foundries to shorten design-to-manufacturing cycles and ensure mass-production yield.
quarterly_data.figure: 800G and 1.6T optical module PICs in customer testing / design iteration

quarterly_data.quarter: Lightelligence press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended June (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management outlook (results announcement): as AI clusters scale from thousands to hundreds of thousands of chips, the bottleneck is shifting from single-chip peak performance to interconnect energy efficiency, density and reliability, and interconnects are evolving along LPO, NPO and CPO from electrical chips and copper cables to high-density optics; in China, the challenges electrical chips face at advanced process nodes compel an even faster transition from electrical to optical interconnects. The company believes silicon photonic chips have become an irreplaceable core component of computing-power upgrades; with the DSP removed and signal processing moved back to the host, it aims to co-design end-to-end signal-integrity links with GPU, switch-chip and packaging partners, and is building localized technical support for international clients.

quarterly_data.quarter: Lightelligence press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended June (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Optical computing (H1 2026): PACE 2 shipments continued with stable deployment in edge computing scenarios; at WAIC 2026 the company launched 'PACE 2 LightCube', an integrated optoelectronic computing machine powered by PACE 2 for edge and linear-computing acceleration (called the world's first by the company). For the next-generation chip PACE 3, both the PIC and EIC have been delivered for tape-out and the PIC has returned from fabrication, with system validation to follow; PACE 3 is designed for large-model inference and multi-card interconnection scaling.
